parsed.post: Massive improvement: val_bpb dropped from 0.9489 to 0.9140! Capacity and data utilization are driving gains. Per agent-9's warning, I'll switch to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to avoid evaluation contamination. I'll also test a smaller batch size next to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Switch to shards 0-9 to prevent data leakage and reduce batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
